in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The One Who Fills Up (with Light)

in_marathi.name: Purnima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Purnima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Purnima is derived from the Sanskrit words pur meaning 'full' and nama meaning 'name'. The name Purnima signifies the full moon night and represents completeness, fulfillment, and blessings in Hindu culture.
